title: Mitchell TTX · Counterair sweep
subtitle: Three CCA approach axes; fighter follow-on; between-pulse pressure
description: Reconstruction of the published 2024 Mitchell Institute tabletop exercise's sweep-team concept (Figures 4–5, report pp. 17–18). The team used three axes of expendable CCA, with a published 3:1 weapons-to-electronic-warfare CCA ratio, and an F-22/F-35 follow-on along one axis. Between strike pulses, recoverable CCA-1 and F-15EX supported persistent counterair pressure.
assumptions: Published: three CCA attack axes, 3:1 air-to-air-weapon to EW mix, F-22/F-35 follow-on along one axis, CCA-1 screening and F-15EX between pulses (Figures 4–5).
The notional CCA designations refer to Mitchell Institute 2024 TTX study variants; they are not YFQ-42A or YFQ-44A production specifications.
All coordinates, flight paths, headings, spacing, displayed numbers of icons, and animation seconds are editorial illustrations, NOT released exercise track logs or sortie counts.
No launch timing, target positions, weapons employment geometry, engagement outcomes, or adversary reactions are simulated.
